# Citizenship Italia

> Citizenship Italia is an Italian citizenship by descent firm serving Americans, with offices in Toronto and its legal team based in Turin, Italy. We offer end-to-end services for consulate applications, court (ATQ) cases, and 1948 maternal line cases. Licensed Italian legal representation included.

## Core Services

- [How It Works](https://citizenshipitalia.com/process.html) — 6-step end-to-end process for Italian citizenship by descent (Jure Sanguinis)
- [Check Eligibility](https://citizenshipitalia.com/check-eligibility.html) — Free 2-minute eligibility quiz for Italian citizenship by descent
- [Pricing](https://citizenshipitalia.com/pricing.html) — Service packages for consulate, court (ATQ), and 1948 routes
- [Our Team](https://citizenshipitalia.com/our-team.html) — Licensed Italian lawyers and citizenship specialists

## Application Routes

## About

Citizenship Italia helps Americans of Italian descent reclaim their Italian (EU) citizenship. We provide end-to-end services including lineage verification, document procurement, certified translation, apostille processing, and licensed Italian legal representation for all three application routes: consulate, ATQ court, and 1948 cases. Court cases are filed with the competent Italian court, generally the one for the area where the Italian ancestor was born.

For comprehensive documentation, see: https://citizenshipitalia.com/llms-full.txt
